name: go-jira-204ada8a-blind28-ots
instr:
# Repairing a Go REST client for a work tracker without a test suite

Driving this library against a stub server that answers every call exactly the way the real system does, a large number of everyday operations now come back wrong, and the shape is nearly always one of three: a call whose exchange with the server went through perfectly announces a failure that never happened, or it quietly hands back nothing whatever with no complaint attached, or the call that reaches the server has been stripped of the parameters that were handed in. The repository has received 28 separate undocumented edits.

Recording and changing things is where a caller notices first. Filing a work item from a body carrying only a description no longer yields the stored record, even though the server replies with the full stored payload and a success meaning it was written; reading that work item back by its identifier afterwards still behaves. Amending a work item by its key with a plain map of attributes, against a server that acknowledges with an empty success, comes back without the reply handle the caller needs. Amending a note already stored on a work item returns no note although the server echoes the stored note back. Amending a milestone that a batch of work is slated for returns neither the milestone nor a complaint, though the server accepted the change. Shifting a batch of two work-item keys into an iteration reports an error to the caller although the server accepted the batch and the pay
